title: How Sieve hired its first recruiter, then three technical hires, each in ~3 weeks from intro
summary: Sieve’s first Contrario hire was its own recruiter. Then he and our network filled a research lead, an FDE and an ML engineer for the video AI lab.
body_markdown: Sieve is a YC-backed AI research lab, one of the few working entirely on video and physical AI data. Its 50-person team trains video models, produces high-quality training data, and sits with customers to turn open-ended requests into working pipelines. With demand from AI labs outpacing headcount, no one had time left for hiring.
